paragraphs: With a global mission to aggregate the best in TV, including premium sports, news and entertainment content, through a single app, Fubo aims to transcend the industry's current TV model.

We are a sports-first, Pay TV replacement product offering subscribers access to tens of thousands of live sporting events annually, alongside leading news and entertainment content, both live and on demand. Fubo's platform is designed to empower customers to seamlessly access content through streaming devices and on Smart TVs, mobile phones, tablets, and computers.

Live TV streaming has disrupted the traditional Pay TV model (linear video delivered via cable or satellite providers for a paid subscription), which we refer to as "Pay TV." This disruption has shifted billions of dollars in subscription and advertising revenue to over-the-top ("OTT") streaming platforms, as evidenced by the accelerating rate of Pay TV cord-cutting in the United States. We believe there remains a significant opportunity for us to capitalize on the cord-cutting movement.

We offer subscribers a live TV streaming service with the option to purchase incremental features, including additional content or enhanced functionality ("Attachments") best suited to their preferences. Our subscription packages (including Fubo Essential, Pro, Elite, and others) boast a broad mix of top Nielsen-ranked channels across sports, news, and entertainment. Our offering sits on a proprietary technology platform built specifically for live TV and sports viewership, leveraging our first-party data. This enables us to consistently introduce new features and functionalities. Unlike video on demand ("VOD")-only services, live TV streaming demands sophisticated infrastructure due to the nuances of regularly refreshing live programming. Notably, our video delivery platform caters to all major sports leagues and entertainment content owners. For example, Apple TV and certain Roku users can enjoy MultiView, allowing them to watch up to four live streams simultaneously. Moreover, we leverage data across the organization to acquire subscriber-preferred content, influence product design and strategy, boost subscriber engagement, and enhance the capabilities and performance of our advertising platform for partners.

Our direct-to-consumer model grants us further insight by capturing billions of data points monthly. This data set drives our continuous innovation, shaping our enhanced user experience, product and content strategy, and differentiated advertising approach. By analyzing this data, we can personalize live and on-demand content discovery in real-time, creating relevant suggestions for each subscriber.

Our growth strategy includes acquiring subscribers who are attracted to our sports offering and can find with us a compelling sports, news, and entertainment viewing alternative to a traditional Pay TV service. We actively engage those subscribers by providing a seamless Pay TV replacement through a personalized easy-to-use streaming product at competitive prices with greater convenience and flexibility than traditional Pay TV providers. We then monetize our audience through subscription fees and our digital advertising offering. In 2022, 2023, and 2024 the majority of our revenue was generated from the sale of subscription services and the sale of advertisements in the United States, though the Company also has operations in Canada, Spain and France.

On January 6, 2025, the Company announced it had entered into a business combination agreement (the "Business Combination Agreement") by and among the Company, The Walt Disney Company ("Disney") and Hulu, LLC ("Hulu"), which contemplates, among other things, (i) Hulu contributing certain assets (the "HL Business Assets") related to the business of negotiating and administering carriage agreements and similar contracts relating to and for the purpose of the retransmission, distribution, carriage, display or broadcast of any programming service, channel or network on the HL DMVPD Service (as defined below) to a newly formed entity to be jointly owned by Hulu and the Company ("Newco"), (ii) the Company undergoing an umbrella partnership C corporation reorganization (the "Up-C Reorganization") and contributing its business to Newco in exchange for units in Newco ("Newco Units") such that, after giving effect to such contribution, Hulu will hold a number of Newco Units representing, in the aggregate, a 70% economic interest in Newco and the Company will hold a number of Newco Units representing, in the aggregate, a 30% economic interest in Newco, and (iii) the Company issuing to Hulu shares of a newly created vote-only class of the Company's common stock ("Class B Common Stock") representing, in the aggregate, a 70% voting interest in the Company (calculated on a fully-diluted basis) (the transactions contemplated by the Business Combination Agreement, collectively, the "Business Combination). The HL Business Assets will include certain carriage agreements, rights under joint subscription agreements and related data and information about its subscribers, advertising or sponsorship agreements exclusively related to Hulu's linear multi-channel subscription video programming distribution service component of the offering known as "Hulu + Live TV" as of the date of the Business Combination Agreement and operated by Hulu (such service, the "HL DMVPD Service"), all other assets (including intellectual property) exclusively related to the HL DMVPD Service and all intellectual property constituting the "Live TV" brand.

Upon the closing of the Business Combination (the "Closing"), our Board of Directors will initially be comprised of nine members, who will be designated as follows: (i) five designated by Hulu, (ii) two designated by the members of our Board as of immediately prior to the Closing and who (x) are reasonably acceptable to Hulu and (y) qualify as independent, (iii) one designated by Hulu and who qualifies as independent and (iv) our CEO. Following the Closing, the Company will be a "controlled company" for purposes of NYSE listing rules and will elect to be exempt from certain corporate governance requirements available to "controlled companies". Completion of the Business Combination is subject to certain closing conditions specified in the Business Combination Agreement, including (i) the approval of the Business Combination Agreement, the Fubo Issuance and the Fubo Conversion, each as defined in the Business Combination Agreement, (including a plan of conversion and a certificate of incorporation of Fubo) by the Company's shareholders, (ii) the expiration or termination of any applicable waiting period under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act of 1976, as amended, and the clearance or obtainment of applicable consents of any specified governmental entity required to be obtained with respect to the Business Combination under the Business Combination Agreement; (iii) no enactment, issuance, promulgation or grant of any law or order, as applicable, by any governmental entity that is in effect and that has the effect of making the Business Combination illegal or prohibiting or otherwise preventing the consummation of the Business Combination, (iv) completion of the Hulu Reorganization and the Fubo Reorganization, each as defined in the Business Combination Agreement, in each case, in accordance with the Business Combination Agreement and the documents contemplated therein, (v) the acceptance of the Delaware Certificate of Conversion and Certificate of Incorporation of Fubo by the Secretary of State of the State of Delaware and the acceptance of the Florida Articles of Conversion by the Florida Department of State, (vi) the accuracy of the other party's representations and warranties as of the date of the Business Combination Agreement, subject to certain customary materiality standards set forth in the Business Combination Agreement and the delivery by each party to the other party of a certificate certifying the same, (vii) compliance by each party, in all material respects, with its applicable pre-Closing obligations under the Business Combination Agreement, and (viii) delivery by each party to the other party of certain other closing deliverables, including, but not limited to, the ancillary agreements to which it is a party.

Streaming services have experienced rapid growth in adoption as consumers engage with streaming video and audio through a variety of devices, including connected TVs, mobile phones, and tablets. While traditional Pay TV still accounts for a meaningful share of TV viewing hours for U.S. households, the proportion is declining as customers continue cutting the cord. We believe consumers are increasingly favoring the superior customer experience, competitive pricing, and better value of streaming services.

Sports and news content have been a key driver for Pay TV operators to retain and grow audiences. Historically most streaming subscription services primarily focused on entertainment content offerings, requiring sports fans to, until recently, remain tethered to the Pay TV ecosystem. This positions our offering well to provide a Pay TV replacement service via streaming that also features an enhanced live sports and news viewing experience.

Our business motto is "come for the sports, stay for the entertainment." This consists of leveraging sporting events to acquire subscribers at efficient acquisition costs, given the built-in demand for sports. We then leverage our technology and data to drive higher engagement and induce retentive behaviors such as watching content, favoriting channels, recording shows, and increasing discovery through our proprietary machine learning recommendations engine. We monetize our growing base of highly engaged subscribers by driving higher average revenue per user ("ARPU").
We drive our business model with three core strategies: •Grow our paid subscriber base •Optimize our content portfolio, engagement and retention
•Increase monetization through subscription and advertising

Our live TV streaming platform caters to sports, news, and entertainment fans. With flexible plans and optional "Attachments," users can customize their experience. The subscription packages boast over 100+ channels, including top Nielsen-rated networks, and dozens of sports, news, and entertainment options. They may also feature numerous Regional Sports Networks ("RSNs") for in-market games unavailable on national channels. Subscribers can further tailor their experience by adding premium channels and channel packages, or upgrading "Attachments" like Cloud DVR Plus for more storage and Family Share for additional simultaneous streams.

headings: Risks Related to Our Financial Position and Capital Needs
We have incurred operating losses in the past, expect to incur operating losses in the future and may never achieve or maintain profitability.
We may require additional capital to meet our financial obligations and support planned business growth, and this capital might not be available on acceptable terms or at all.
Our revenue is subject to seasonality, and if subscriber behavior during certain seasons falls below our expectations, our business may be harmed.
We might not be able to utilize a significant portion of our net operating loss carryforwards.
Our financial condition and results of operations could be adversely affected if we do not effectively manage our current or future debt.
Servicing our indebtedness will require a significant amount of cash, and we may not have sufficient cash flow from our business to pay our substantial indebtedness.
Our operating results may fluctuate, which makes our results difficult to predict.
If we fail to effectively manage our growth, our business, operating results, and financial condition may suffer.
Risks Relating to the Business Combination
The Business Combination Agreement contains provisions that may discourage other companies from trying to acquire Fubo.
Fubo has incurred, and will continue to incur, direct and indirect costs as a result of the Business Combination.
Litigation challenging the Business Combination Agreement and the Business Combination may prevent the Business Combination from being consummated within the expected timeframe or at all.
Risks Related to Our Relationships with Content Providers, Customers and Other Third Parties
The long-term nature of certain of our content commitments may limit our operating flexibility and could adversely affect our liquidity and results of operations.
Our results may be adversely affected if long-term content contracts are not renewed on sufficiently favorable terms.
If we fail to obtain or maintain popular content, we may fail to retain existing subscribers and attract new subscribers.
If our efforts to attract and retain subscribers are not successful, our business will be adversely affected.
Our agreements with certain distribution partners may contain parity obligations which limit our ability to pursue unique partnerships.
If we are unable to maintain an adequate supply of ad inventory on our platform, our business may be harmed.
If content providers refuse to license streaming content or other rights upon terms acceptable to us, our business could be adversely affected.
Our content providers impose a number of restrictions on how we distribute and market our products and services, which can adversely affect our business.
Our agreements with content providers are complex, with various rights restrictions and favorability obligations which impose onerous compliance obligations.
paragraphs: You should carefully consider the risks and uncertainties described below, together with all of the other information in this Annual Report, including our consolidated financial statements and related notes and the section titled "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations." Our business, financial condition, results of operations, or prospects could also be harmed by risks and uncertainties not currently known to us or that we currently do not believe are material. If any of the risks actually occur, our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects could be adversely affected. In that event, the market price of our common stock could decline, and you could lose part or all of your investment.

This Annual Report also contains forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties. See "Forward-Looking Statements." Our actual results could differ materially and adversely from those anticipated in these forward-looking statements as a result of certain factors, including those set forth below.

We have incurred losses since inception. Our net loss on continuing operations for the year ended December 31, 2024 was $177.8 million. We expect that expanding our operations and pursuing growth opportunities will cause our future operating expenses to increase. If our revenue does not grow at a greater rate than our operating expenses, we will not be able to achieve and maintain profitability. A number of our operating expenses, including expenses related to streaming content obligations, are fixed. If we are not able to either reduce these fixed obligations or other expenses or maintain or grow our revenue, our near-term operating losses may increase. Additionally, we may encounter unforeseen operating or legal expenses, difficulties, complications, delays and other factors, including, without limitation, in connection with the Business Combination, that may result in losses in future periods. If our expenses exceed our revenue, we may never achieve or maintain profitability and our business may be harmed.

We have made, and intend in the future to make, significant investments to support planned business growth and may require additional funds to respond to business challenges, including the need to develop new features or enhance our existing platform, products and services, increase marketing efforts to acquire and retain subscribers, expand into additional markets around the world, improve our operating infrastructure or merge with or acquire complementary businesses, personnel and technologies. Accordingly, we may need to secure additional funds. If we raise additional funds through future issuances of equity or convertible debt securities, including pursuant to our shelf registration statements on Form S-3, our then existing shareholders could suffer significant dilution, and any new equity securities we issue could have rights, preferences and privileges superior to those of holders of our common stock. Any debt financing we secure, including the senior unsecured term loan available to us on January 5, 2026 and described elsewhere in this Annual Report (the "Facility"), could involve restrictive covenants relating to our capital raising activities and other financial and operational matters, which may make it more difficult for us to obtain additional capital and to pursue business opportunities, including potential acquisitions. If we were to violate the restrictive covenants contained in the indenture governing our 2029 Convertible Notes (the "2029 notes indenture") or in any future document governing our indebtedness, we could incur penalties, increased expenses and an acceleration of the payment terms of our outstanding debt, which could in turn harm our business. In addition, if the Business Combination is completed as contemplated as of the date hereof and as described elsewhere in this Annual Report, we will be required to offer to repurchase any of our outstanding 3.25% senior convertible notes due 2026 (the "2026 Convertible Notes") and convertible senior secured notes due 2029 (the "2029 Convertible Notes") at a repurchase price equal to 100% of the principal amount of such notes to be repurchased, plus accrued and unpaid interest, if any. We may not have enough available cash or be able to obtain financing at the time we are required to make repurchases of 2026 Convertible Notes or 2029 Convertible Notes surrendered therefor.

We may not be able to obtain additional financing on terms favorable to us, if at all, due to unfavorable market conditions, including rising interest rates, or otherwise. In addition, the 2029 notes indenture, and the exchange agreement entered into in connection with the issuance of the 2029 Convertible Notes (the "Exchange Agreement"), restrict our ability to incur certain indebtedness and issue certain equity securities. If we are unable to obtain adequate financing or financing on terms satisfactory to us when we require it, our ability to support our business growth and to respond to business challenges could be significantly impaired, and our business may be harmed.

In addition, our cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash are maintained at financial institutions in amounts that exceed federally insured limits. In the event of failure of any of the financial institutions where we maintain our cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash, there can be no assurance that we will be able to access uninsured funds in a timely manner or at all, and we may be obligated to seek alternative sources of liquidity.

paragraphs: 本公司以全球為目標，透過單一應用程式，整合最佳的電視內容，包括高品質體育、新聞及娛樂內容。Fubo 的目標是超越現有電視產業的模式。
本公司為以體育為核心的 Pay TV 替代產品，提供訂閱者每年可觀看數萬場現場體育賽事的服務，同時也提供領先的新聞及娛樂內容，包括即時與點播服務。Fubo 的平台設計為讓客戶能透過串流裝置及智慧電視、行動電話、平板電腦與電腦，順暢地存取內容。
現場電視串流已顛覆傳統的 Pay TV 模式（透過有線或衛星供應商提供線性視訊的付費訂閱服務），我們稱此為 "Pay TV"。此種顛覆已將數十億美元的訂閱與廣告收入轉移到串流平台（"OTT"），如美國加速的 Pay TV 解約趨勢所顯示。我們相信，我們仍有機會從解約風潮中獲取顯著的商機。

本公司提供訂閱者現場電視串流服務，並提供購買附加功能的選項，包括額外內容或增強功能（"Attachments"），以符合其偏好。我們的訂閱方案（包括 Fubo Essential、Pro、Elite 及其他方案）擁有廣泛的 Nielsen 排名頻道，涵蓋體育、新聞與娛樂。我們的服務建立在專屬的技術平台上，專為現場電視與體育觀看設計，並利用我們的自有數據。這使我們能持續推出新功能與特性。與僅提供點播（"VOD"）服務不同，現場電視串流需要複雜的基礎設施，因需定期更新現場節目。值得注意的是，我們的視訊傳輸平台服務於所有主要體育聯盟與娛樂內容擁有者。例如，Apple TV 以及部分 Roku 使用者可使用 MultiView，允許他們同時觀看最多四個現場串流。此外，我們利用組織內的數據，以取得訂閱者偏好的內容、影響產品設計與策略、提高訂閱者參與度，並提升我們廣告平台對合作夥伴的效能與表現。
我們的直營消費者模式使我們能進一步掌握數據，每月捕捉數十億個數據點。此數據集驅動我們的持續創新，塑造我們的增強用戶體驗、產品與內容策略，以及差異化的廣告方法。透過分析此數據，我們能即時個人化現場與點播內容的發現，為每位訂閱者創造相關的建議。

我們的成長策略包括吸引對我們體育服務感興趣的訂閱者，並為他們提供一個有吸引力的體育、新聞與娛樂觀看替代方案，以取代傳統的 Pay TV 服務。我們透過提供一個個人化、易用的串流產品，以競爭性價格、更高的便利性與靈活性，來吸引這些訂閱者。我們隨後透過訂閱費與數位廣告服務來 monetize 我們的觀眾。2022 年、2023 年及 2024 年，我們的收入主要來自美國的訂閱服務銷售與廣告銷售，不過本公司也於加拿大、西班牙與法國有營運。

2025 年 1 月 6 日，本公司宣佈已與 The Walt Disney Company（"Disney"）及 Hulu, LLC（"Hulu"）簽訂業務合併協議（"Business Combination Agreement"），該協議預期包含以下事項：(i) Hulu 將貢獻與其業務相關的特定資產（"HL Business Assets"），包括與談判及管理電信業者協議及類似合同相關的資產，這些合同用於重新傳輸、分發、運輸、顯示或廣播任何節目服務、頻道或網路，透過 HL DMVPD 服務（如後文所定義），至一個新成立的實體（"Newco"），該實體將由 Hulu 與本公司共同擁有；(ii) 本公司將進行一個傘型合夥 C 股份有限公司重組（"Up-C Reorganization"），並將其業務貢獻至 Newco 以換取 Newco 的單位（"Newco Units"），使得在完成此貢獻後，Hulu 將持有代表 Newco 經濟權益 70% 的 Newco Units，而本公司將持有代表 Newco 經濟權益 30% 的 Newco Units；(iii) 本公司將發行給 Hulu 一類新創的僅投票權普通股（"Class B Common Stock"），代表本公司投票權 70%（以完全稀釋後計算）。這些交易即為 Business Combination Agreement 所預期的交易（"Business Combination"）。HL Business Assets 將包括與 Hulu 的線性多頻道視訊節目分發服務（"Hulu + Live TV"）相關的特定電信業者協議、聯合訂閱協議下的權利及相關的數據與資訊，以及與 Hulu 的訂閱者、廣告或贊助協議相關的資訊，這些服務於 Business Combination Agreement 簽訂時為 Hulu 所經營（此服務稱為 "HL DMVPD 服務"），所有其他與 HL DMVPD 服務相關的資產（包括智慧財產權）以及構成 "Live TV" 品牌的智慧財產權。

在 Business Combination（"Closing"）完成後，我們的董事會將最初由九名成員組成，這些成員將如下指定：(i) 五名由 Hulu 指定；(ii) 兩名由我們在 Closing 前的董事會成員指定，且 (x) 經 Hulu 合理接受，且 (y) 滿足獨立性標準；(iii) 一名由 Hulu 指定且符合獨立性標準的成員；(iv) 我們的 CEO。在 Closing 後，本公司將根據紐約證券交易所的上市規則，成為一間 "controlled company"，並選擇免除適用於 "controlled companies" 的某些公司治理要求。完成 Business Combination 取決於 Business Combination Agreement 中所規定的某些 Closing 條件，包括 (i) 本公司股東對 Business Combination Agreement、Fubo Issuance 及 Fubo Conversion 的批准（如 Business Combination Agreement 中所定義），包括 Fubo 的轉換計畫及章程（"Certificate of Incorporation"）；(ii) 任何適用的 Hart-Scott-Rodino 反壟斷改進法案（1976 年）的等待期屆滿或終止，以及取得適用的政府機構對 Business Combination 的批准或同意；(iii) 沒有任何政府機構頒布、頒佈或頒發任何法律或命令，使 Business Combination 非法或禁止或否則阻止其完成；(iv) 完成 Hulu Reorganization 及 Fubo Reorganization，如 Business Combination Agreement 中所定義，並依照 Business Combination Agreement 及相關文件進行；(v) 德州州務卿接受 Delaware Certificate of Conversion 及 Fubo 的 Certificate of Incorporation，以及佛羅裏達州州務卿接受 Florida Articles of Conversion；(vi) 雙方在 Business Combination Agreement 簽訂日時的陳述與保證準確無誤，符合 Business Combination Agreement 中所規定的某些常見重大性標準，並由雙方提供證書證明；(vii) 雙方在所有重大方面遵守其在 Closing 前的適用義務；(viii) 雙方提供某些其他 Closing 文件，包括但不限於其為一方的附屬協議。
串流服務已因消費者透過連網電視、行動電話及平板等多種裝置使用串流影片及音訊而快速成長。雖然傳統付費電視仍佔美國家庭電視觀看時數的重要比例，但隨著消費者持續取消有線電視訂閱，此比例正持續下降。我們認為消費者越來越偏好串流服務的優越使用體驗、競爭性價格及更好的價值。
體育及新聞內容一直是付費電視運營商維持及擴大觀眾羣的重要驅動力。歷史上，大多數串流訂閱服務主要聚焦於娛樂內容，因此直到最近，體育迷仍需依賴付費電視生態系統。這使我們的服務能提供一個取代付費電視的串流服務，並具備增強的即時體育及新聞觀看體驗。
我們的經營理念為『為體育而來，為娛樂而留』。這意味著我們利用體育賽事來以高效的獲客成本取得訂戶，因為體育本身就具有內建需求。我們隨後利用我們的科技與數據來提高參與度，並促使訂戶產生留存行為，例如觀看內容、收藏頻道、錄製節目，以及透過我們的專有機器學習推薦引擎增加內容發現。我們透過提高每位用戶的平均收入（"ARPU"）來賺取我們不斷成長的高參與度訂戶羣。
我們的商業模式以三大核心策略為主導：•擴大付費訂戶數量 •優化內容組合、參與度及留存率
•透過訂閱與廣告提高收益

我們的即時電視串流平台專為體育、新聞及娛樂愛好者而設。透過靈活的訂閱方案及可選的『附加功能』，用戶可以自訂其體驗。訂閱方案包含超過 100 個頻道，包括 Nielsen 當前評價最高的電視網，以及數十種體育、新聞及娛樂選項。他們還可加入多個區域體育頻道（"RSNs"）以觀看當地市場中無法在國家頻道播出的比賽。訂戶進一步可透過加入高階頻道及頻道組合，或升級『附加功能』如 Cloud DVR Plus 以獲得更多儲存空間及 Family Share 以增加同時串流數量。

paragraphs: 於 2025 年 1 月 6 日，本公司宣佈已與 The Walt Disney Company（"Disney"）及 Hulu, LLC（"Hulu"）簽訂業務合併協議（"業務合併協議"），該協議預期包含多項事項，包括（i）Hulu 將其與 negotiating and administering carriage agreements 及 similar contracts 有關的資產（"HL 商業資產"）轉讓至由 Hulu 與本公司共同擁有之新設公司（"Newco"），該資產包括與 HL DMVPD 服務（如下所定）之 retransmission, distribution, carriage, display 或 broadcast 有關的 programming service, channel 或 network 的 carriage agreements、joint subscription agreements 及相關 data 和 subscriber、advertising 或 sponsorship agreements，（ii）本公司進行 umbrella partnership C corporation 重組（"Up-C 重組"），並將其業務轉讓至 Newco 以換取 Newco 的 units（"Newco units"），使得在完成此轉讓後，Hulu 將持有代表其在 Newco 中 70% 經濟權益的 Newco units，本公司將持有代表其在 Newco 中 30% 經濟權益的 Newco units，以及（iii）本公司向 Hulu 發行新創設之 vote-only class 的普通股（"Class B 普通股"），代表本公司 70% 的投票權（以 fully-diluted 為計算基礎）（業務合併協議所預期的交易，合稱為 "業務合併"）。HL 商業資產將包括與 HL DMVPD 服務（如下所定）有關的 carriage agreements、joint subscription agreements 的權利及相關 data 和 subscriber、advertising 或 sponsorship agreements，這些 agreements 僅與 Hulu 之 linear multi-channel subscription video programming distribution service component（即 "Hulu + Live TV"）有關，該 service 由 Hulu 運作（此 service 稱為 "HL DMVPD 服務"），所有其他與 HL DMVPD 服務相關的資產（包括智慧財產權）及所有構成 "Live TV" 品牌的智慧財產權。

於業務合併完成（"完成"）後，本公司董事會將由九名成員組成，其指定方式如下：（i）由 Hulu 指定五名，（ii）由本公司在完成前的董事會成員指定兩名，且（x）為 Hulu 合理接受，（y）符合獨立董事標準，（iii）由 Hulu 指定一名且符合獨立董事標準，以及（iv）本公司 CEO。完成後，本公司將根據紐約證券交易所上市規則被視為 "受控制公司"，並選擇免除適用於 "受控制公司" 的某些公司治理要求。業務合併之完成需符合業務合併協議中所規定的某些完成條件，包括（i）本公司股東批准業務合併協議、Fubo 發行及 Fubo 轉換（如業務合併協議中所定義），（包括 Fubo 轉換計畫及 Fubo 公司章程），（ii）任何適用之 Hart-Scott-Rodino 反壟斷改進法案 1976 年版（經修訂）之等待期屆滿或終止，以及取得業務合併協議中所規定之任何指定政府機構的相關同意；（iii）任何政府機構未頒布、頒布、頒布或授予任何法律或命令，該法律或命令現行且使業務合併違法或禁止或以其他方式阻止業務合併之完成，（iv）完成 Hulu 重組及 Fubo 重組（如業務合併協議中所定義），並符合業務合併協議及相關文件之規定，（v）Delaware 總督辦公室接受 Delaware 轉換證書及 Fubo 公司章程，以及 Florida 州長辦公室接受 Florida 轉換章程，（vi）雙方在業務合併協議簽訂日時之陳述與保證為準確，符合業務合併協議中所規定之某些常見重大性標準，並由雙方各自向對方交付證書以證明此項，（vii）雙方在所有重大方面遵守其在完成前根據業務合併協議所應履行的義務，以及（viii）雙方各自向對方交付某些其他完成文件，包括但不限於其為一方之 ancillary agreements。
在 Fubo Gaming 解散及 Fubo Sportsbook 終止的同時，本公司前 wagering 報告分部的資產與負債及運營已於所有期間內列為已終止業務。就本公司持續運營而言，本公司僅運作一個報告分部。

headings: 與本公司財務狀況及資金需求相關之風險
本公司過去曾產生營運虧損，預期未來亦可能產生營運虧損，且可能永遠無法達成或維持獲利狀態。
本公司可能需要額外資金以履行財務義務並支應計畫中的業務成長，而此資金可能無法以可接受之條件或完全無法取得。
本公司營收受季節性影響，若特定季節之用戶行為低於本公司預期，將可能對本公司業務造成損害。
本公司可能無法有效利用我們淨營業虧損結轉利益之重大部分。
若本公司無法有效管理目前或未來之債務，將可能對本公司財務狀況及營運成果造成不利影響。
償還本公司債務將需要大量現金，而本公司可能無法從業務中產生足夠之現金流量以償還重大債務。
本公司營運成果可能波動，使本公司成果難以預測。
若我們未能有效管理成長，將可能影響本公司業務、營運結果及財務狀況。
與業務組合相關的風險
業務組合協議包含可能阻止其他公司嘗試收購 Fubo 的條款。
Fubo 已產生，並將持續產生直接及間接成本，係因業務組合所致。
挑戰業務組合協議及業務組合的訴訟可能導致業務組合無法在預期時間內或完全無法完成。
與我們與內容供應商、客戶及其他第三方關係相關的風險
部分內容承諾的長期性可能限制我們的營運彈性，並可能對我們的流動性及營運結果產生不利影響。
若長期內容合約未能以足夠有利的條款續約，將可能對我們的結果產生不利影響。
若我們無法取得或維持受歡迎的內容，我們可能無法留住現有訂戶並吸引新訂戶。
若我們吸引及留住訂戶的措施未能成功，將對我們的業務產生不利影響。
我們與部分分發夥伴的協議可能包含parity義務，限制我們追求獨特合作夥伴的能力。
若我們無法在平台上維持足夠的廣告存貨，將可能對我們的業務造成損害。
若內容供應商拒絕以我們可接受的條件授權串流內容或其他權利，將可能對我們的業務產生不利影響。
我們的內容供應商對我們如何分發及行銷我們的產品與服務施加許多限制，這可能對我們的業務產生不利影響。
我們與內容供應商的協議複雜，包含各種權利限制與優待義務，這些義務對我們造成嚴格的合規要求。
paragraphs: 您應仔細考慮下列所描述的風險與不確定性，並配合本年度報告中的所有其他資訊，包括我們的合併財務報表及其相關附註，以及標題為「管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之討論與分析」的章節。我們的業務、財務狀況、營運結果或前景，也可能因目前未知或我們目前認為不具重大影響的風險與不確定性而受到損害。如果任何風險實際發生，我們的業務、財務狀況、營運結果與前景可能會受到不利影響。在此情況下，本公司普通股的市場價格可能會下跌，您可能會損失部分或全部投資。
本年度報告也包含涉及風險與不確定性的展望性陳述。請參閱「展望性陳述」。我們實際的結果可能與這些展望性陳述中預期的結果有顯著且不利的差異，原因可能是某些因素，包括下列所列的那些因素。

本公司自設立以來即產生虧損。本公司於2024年12月31日財務年度終了之持續經營業務淨虧損為177.8 百萬美元。本公司預期擴大營運規模並追求成長機會將導致未來營運費用增加。若本公司營業收入無法以高於營運費用的速率成長，將無法達成並維持獲利。本公司部分營運費用，包括與串流內容義務相關之費用，屬固定費用。若本公司無法降低這些固定義務或其他費用，或無法維持或成長營業收入，近期營運虧損可能增加。此外，本公司可能遭遇未預見之營運或法律費用、困難、複雜問題、延誤及其他因素，包括但不限於與企業併購相關之因素，可能導致未來期間產生虧損。若本公司費用高於營業收入，將可能永遠無法達成或維持獲利，且本公司業務可能受損。

本公司已進行並計畫未來持續進行重大投資以支應預期的業務成長，並可能需要額外資金以應對業務挑戰，包括開發新功能或升級現有平台、產品與服務、增加行銷活動以取得及留住訂戶、擴展至全球其他市場、改善營運基礎設施或與補充性業務、人力與技術進行合併或收購。因此，本公司可能需要取得額外資金。若本公司透過未來發行股票或可轉換債務證券來籌措資金，包括依循本公司於Form S-3之shelf registration statements所進行的發行，則現有股東可能面臨顯著的稀釋，且本公司所發行之任何新股票可能享有優於本公司普通股持有人之權利、優先權與特權。若本公司取得任何債務融資，包括於2026年1月5日可供本公司使用的高階無擔保定期貸款（稱為"Facility"），可能涉及限制性契約，限制本公司之資金籌措活動及其他財務與營運事項，這可能使本公司更難取得額外資金並追求業務機會，包括潛在之收購。若本公司違反限制性契約，包含於2029年可轉換債券（稱為"2029 notes indenture"）之抵押契約或任何未來之債務契約，本公司可能面臨處罰、增加費用及現有債務之償還期限加速，這可能進一步損害本公司業務。此外，若本次企業併購完成，如本年度報告所預期及描述，本公司將被要求以現金購回任何現有之3.25%高階可轉換債券到期日為2026年（稱為"2026 Convertible Notes"）及高階可轉換secured債券到期日為2029年（稱為"2029 Convertible Notes"），購回價格為該債券本金金額之100%，加上已累計但未支付之利息（如有）。本公司可能在購回2026 Convertible Notes或2029 Convertible Notes時，無法擁有足夠現金或取得融資。

我們可能無法在有利的條件下取得額外資金，甚至無法取得，這是因為市場條件不利，包括利率上升，或其他原因。此外，2029年債券契約（"2029 notes indenture"）及與發行2029年可轉換債券（"2029 Convertible Notes"）相關的交換協議（"Exchange Agreement"）限制我們發行某些債務及發行某些股票的權利。如果我們無法在需要時取得足夠資金或在符合我們要求的條件下取得資金，我們支持業務成長及應對業務挑戰的能力可能受到顯著影響，並可能對業務造成損害。
此外，我們的現金、現金等價物及限制性現金存放在金融機構，金額超過聯邦保險上限。如果任何存放我們現金、現金等價物及限制性現金的金融機構發生問題，無法確保我們能及時或完全取得未保險資金，我們可能需要尋求其他流動性來源。
